name: beat-arena-viewer
description: Beat Arena 3D replay viewer (env v10 full-body dynamics: articulated 29-joint skeleton via full-body FK, contact markers, per-joint torque/omega gauges, foot reaction forces; real Beat Saber object models baked from ScoreSaber's replay viewer), and the Flux WebXR game (play Flux yourself in VR, judged by the env's own Rust compiled to wasm) — Svelte + Threlte SPA, built to a single static HTML file

scripts.build:site: npm run wasm && vite build --mode site
scripts.test: node test/replay.test.js && node test/replay-v2.test.js && node test/urlload.test.js && node test/models.test.js && node test/hud.test.js && node test/sync.test.js && node test/tickrate.test.js && node test/tiptrail.test.js && node test/interp.test.js && node test/flux.test.js && node test/flux-parity.test.js && node test/flux-game.test.js
